name: FirstNet by AT&T
description: Dedicated first responder network with priority access and family line savings
fullDescription: FirstNet is America's dedicated wireless network for first responders and public safety, built as a public-private partnership with the federal government. Provides priority access and dedicated bandwidth during emergencies.
whatTheyOffer:
- Dedicated wireless network for public safety
- First Priority access so responders don't compete with commercial traffic
- About 3 million square miles of coverage
- FirstNet and Family: save up to 20% on AT&T family lines
- Subscriber-paid Responder Unlimited plans for individuals
- Agency plans also available
howToGetIt:
1. Visit firstnet.com to check eligibility
2. Eligible: law enforcement, fire, EMS, 911 dispatchers, and others who support public safety
3. Verify eligibility (individual responders can verify through ID.me)
4. Sign up online or at AT&T/FirstNet retail locations
5. See firstnet.com/plans for current pricing
keywords: FirstNet, AT&T, first responder, police, firefighter, EMT, EMS, 911, emergency, priority network, public safety, healthcare, utilities
